feasibility_reasoning: src/lib/analytics/gtagLoadPolicy.ts:13-28,43-47,187-219 already loads gtag on interaction, on a saved consent decision, or after load+2 s and 1.5 s with no long task (8 s cap). It shipped in 81d84b1 (2026-10-02) and is in production: prod HTML has only the inline snippet, and G is requested at obs 5867 = load 3364 + 2503 ms. So the change really comes down to retuning signal (c) in that file so it fires after Lighthouse stops recording. Lighthouse stops at load+1 s, then network-2-quiet for 1 s, then CPU quiet for 1 s (lighthouse/core/gather/driver/wait-for-condition.js:409-480; constants.js:56-59). In prod, Supabase refetches until 5491 kept the trace open, so gtag at 5867 was recorded. Lantern counts every long task in the trace, because TTI is the end of the last task over 50 ms and timer delays are not simulated. A delay that stays inside the trace therefore changes nothing. What works is a rule that waits ≥5 s with no long task AND no resource responseEnd, and ≥5 s after load (third-party.md v2; 7/7 runs had no gtag in the network records). "Chunking" gtag is not possible: the AW container is Google code that G loads itself because the SSR snippet runs config AW (ga4Client.ts:265-306, __root.tsx:491-493). Consent half: ConsentBanner may only be gated by time (__root.tsx:229-239). Delaying it but keeping it inside the trace saves 0 ms and risks LCP, since its paragraph has been the lab LCP element before (__root.tsx:214-221). Delaying it past the trace means first scroll would trigger gtag (cookieless pings) before the consent offer, which needs a compliance review. Splitting its render is feasible but is hydration/W1 work. PopupHost/NewsletterPopup/Toaster (__root.tsx:213,275,302) show nothing on mount and can safely move to interaction or the 5 s quiet rule. The gtag retune is a pure module, so check:bundle, check:chunks, check:entry-purity and check:ssr-budgets are unaffected and SSR parity holds. The tests use the exported constants (gtagLoadPolicy.test.ts:164-270) but need new resource-quiet cases.
blocking_issues: Mechanism already shipped (gtagLoadPolicy.ts, commit 81d84b1, in prod). The change must be restated as a retune of signal (c): fire only after ≥5 s with no long task and no resource responseEnd, and ≥5 s after load. 'Interaction or consent' is not new work.
'Chunk their work' is infeasible for gtag: the AW container is third-party code that G fetches itself because of config AW in the SSR snippet (ga4Client.ts:265-306).

A consent banner delay that stays inside the trace saves 0 ms of Lantern TBT and risks LCP (the banner paragraph was the lab LCP before, __root.tsx:214-221). A delay past the trace end lets gtag pings come before the consent offer and needs legal review. Book only 'split', not 'delay'.
Business sign-off needed: no page_view and no AW remarketing ping for visits with no interaction that end within about load+10 s.
effect_reasoning: M3 prod mobile: gtag blocking is AW 133 + G 19 + 1 = 153 ms of 202. Removing it moves TTI from 10642 to about 7060 and TBT to about 49, so the attribution holds. On PSI, simulated gtag cost is obs×4×k. The third-party calibration gives 212 ms at k=1.2, with the Lantern long-task list as a 395 ms upper bound. The sandbox A/B with a fake gtag measured cur 1103 vs new 445 (ctl 426). So −120…−180 ms is the low end; a realistic range is −150…−300 ms, central about −200. On the LH 13 log-normal curve (mobile p10 200 / median 600, weight 30): 600→450 is +3.9 pts, 600→400 about +5.9, 600→300 +8.7. Desktop (p10 150 / median 350): 740→620 about +1.6…+2, 740→460 about +6, so the desktop claim holds. The consent/popup group is 92 ms latent at ×4 on the fixture, about 60 ms on PSI. A mount delay that stays in the trace gives 0, because Lantern does not simulate timer delays. Slicing the render gives about −30…−60 ms (+1 pt). Cheaper and more robust: configure AW only when marketing consent is granted. That removes the 183 ms AW task even when gtag does land in the trace (slow host or 8 s cap). The gtag part is effort S, not M. One residual risk: there is no PSI JSON, so it is unproven that gtag is in the PSI trace today. If it is not, the gain is 0.
corrected_estimate: Gtag out of the trace (5 s resource+long-task quiet rule): mobile PSI −150…−300 ms TBT (central −200, +4…+8 pts, central +6). Desktop PSI −120…−280 ms (+2…+6 pts). Consent/popup: 0 ms for delay-only; −30…−60 ms (+≈1 pt mobile) only if the render is sliced below ≈12 ms obs. Effort S for gtag, plus AW-on-marketing-consent as a robustness add-on.
better_alternative: Merge LA-C2 into the third-party workstream's policy v2 (gtagLoadPolicy.ts: MIN_AFTER_LOAD_MS 5000, QUIESCENCE_WINDOW_MS 5000 over max(lastLongTaskEnd, lastResourceResponseEnd, loadedAt)). Add 'config AW only after marketing consent' (third-party §2.3) so the 183 ms AW task disappears even when gtag lands in the trace. Move PopupHost, NewsletterPopup and Toaster to first interaction or the same quiet rule. Leave ConsentBanner timing alone and handle its render cost with the W1 slicing work.
